results.execution_guidance: IMPORTANT: Follow the recommended plan below. Extract steps before execution, adapt to your current context, execute sequentially with current_step parameter, and check known pitfalls to avoid errors.
recommended_plan_steps: [Optional (if you suspect outages/auth issues)] [Prerequisite]: Precheck GTmetrix availability/account status using GTMETRIX_GET_STATUS (reduce test-start failures).
[Optional (if you need to choose region/browser)] [Prerequisite]: Discover valid options using GTMETRIX_GET_LOCATIONS and GTMETRIX_GET_BROWSERS (avoid rejected config values).
[Required] [Step]: Start an audit using GTMETRIX_START_TEST (submit the target url and any chosen options).
[Required] [Next Step]: Poll for completion using GTMETRIX_GET_TEST (wait for terminal status and capture the report identifier).
[Required] [Step]: Retrieve final results using GTMETRIX_GET_REPORT (use the report identifier to fetch the completed audit output).
[Optional (if you want a monitoring-style pagespeed check instead of a one-off audit)] [Step]: Create a check using STATUSCAKE_CREATE_PAGESPEED_TEST (track ongoing performance for the url).
known_pitfalls: [GTMETRIX_START_TEST] URL must be fully qualified (include scheme like https://); invalid formatting can fail test start.
[GTMETRIX_GET_LOCATIONS] Only pass locations returned by GTMETRIX_GET_LOCATIONS; unknown values may be rejected.
[GTMETRIX_GET_BROWSERS] Only pass browsers returned by GTMETRIX_GET_BROWSERS; unsupported values can cause start errors.
[GTMETRIX_GET_TEST] While queued/running, status may not be terminal and report fields can be missing—continue polling until complete.
[GTMETRIX_GET_REPORT] Requires the report identifier from GTMETRIX_GET_TEST; losing it prevents retrieving the finished report.

GTMETRIX_START_TEST.description: Tool to start a new GTmetrix test for a specified URL. Use when you need to analyze website performance with configurable options like location, browser, and throttling.

dns.description: Custom DNS host and IP for testing (e.g., ['example.com:1.2.3.4']).

url.description: The URL to test. Must be a valid HTTP or HTTPS URL.

video.description: Enable video generation: 0 for disabled, 1 for enabled.

report.description: Report type: 'lighthouse' for Lighthouse only, 'legacy' for PageSpeed/YSlow, 'lighthouse,legacy' for both, 'none' for metrics-only.

adblock.description: Enable AdBlock: 0 for disabled, 1 for enabled.

throttle.description: Connection throttling in Kbps and latency in ms (e.g., '1500/50' for 1.5 Mbps and 50ms latency).

allow_url.description: Only load resources matching these URL patterns (e.g., ['*.example.com/*']).

block_url.description: Prevent loading resources matching these URL patterns (e.g., ['*.ads.com/*']).

retention.description: Report retention period in months. Must be one of: 1, 6, 12, or 24.

user_agent.description: Custom User Agent string to use for the test.

stop_onload.description: Stop test at window.onload event: 0 for disabled, 1 for enabled.

browser_dppx.description: Device pixel ratio. Must be between 1 and 5.

browser_width.description: Viewport width in pixels. Default is 1366.

browser_height.description: Viewport height in pixels. Default is 768.

browser_rotate.description: Swap viewport width and height (rotate): 0 for disabled, 1 for enabled.

GTMETRIX_GET_TEST.description: Tool to retrieve test details for a specific GTMetrix test. Use when you need to check the status, configuration, or results of a previously initiated test.

GTMETRIX_GET_REPORT.description: Tool to retrieve a GTmetrix test report by its identifier. Use when you need to get comprehensive performance metrics, timing data, and links to resources for a specific report.

report_id.description: Report slug identifier - the unique ID of the report to retrieve.

GTMETRIX_GET_LOCATIONS.description: Tool to retrieve the list of available GTmetrix test locations. Use when you need to see which locations are available for testing and their details including supported browsers and access status.
